description: This file is a shell script used for testing git merge behaviors involving case-changing renames on case-insensitive file systems. It sets up test scenarios, runs git commands, and checks the results.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for prerequisites before running tests.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting it to succeed.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Verifies that a given path is a file.
